rules.name: r_addr
rules.bodyHtml: when CLIENT_ACCEPTED { if { [IP::addr [IP::client_addr] equals 10.0.0.0/8] } { pool /Common/p_v4 member 10.0.0.1%2 80 } elseif { [class match [IP::client_addr] equals /Common/dg_ip] } { node 2001:db8::1 80 } else { pool p_rel } set rd [getfield [IP::client_addr] "%" 2] }
